trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing here is online and no downloadable content is needed, so the whole hunt is single-player. Budget roughly 200 hours across the five chapters, the side strands and the long collectible lists, and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops when it ends. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — just play through the intro until Jason and Lucia are back on dry land. No preparation or side work is needed first.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy does not pop on the final Chapter 1 cutscene — it pops after the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?', so keep playing into the next chapter and it will land. Unmissable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it pops after the first mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City', rather than at the end of Chapter 2 itself. Just keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so do not worry if it stays locked when Chapter 3 ends. Keep playing the story and it will pop early in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The guides tie it to the final Chapter 4 mission, 'Starting From Zero', and it pops as the chapter closes. Unmissable — play the story through and it lands without any side work.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. The guides disagree about which chapter the final mission belongs to, so this guide claims none — just play the story to its end. It is the only hidden Gold trophy, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Story missions cannot be missed: play through Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the mission ends. No extra objective is needed — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Play the story until the heist is done and the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is unmissable, so there is nothing to prepare and no way to lock yourself out of it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the mission ends, and story missions cannot be missed, so just keep playing the story. No side activity or collectible feeds into it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the end of it. Like every story-mission trophy it is unmissable — the story itself hands it to you.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops. It is unmissable, so there is no preparation and no way to miss it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Both guides place this mission in Chapter 5, the final chapter of the story. Play through to the mission's end and the trophy pops; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion, found under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist only appears after the story. Progress made earlier still counts. Partial thresholds count toward it: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans, plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Track your count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Note that 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if you want the Platinum.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball (sink a basket), an arcade or video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Track your count under Progress, then Activities. Any one of each type is enough — you do not need to master any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps elsewhere. Work through the ranges one at a time and use each range's own scoring feedback to learn its challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in total, and 100% completion needs all 42. Each location hosts several races, so learn the course, then win at least one race per location. The trophy counts locations, not total wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Forty races exist across Leonida, but repeats do not count — each win must be at a race you have not won before. Enter races from the map and work through fresh ones until the counter hits 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; he later texts you a purple-marked fishing spot. Follow his fishing questline, take the challenge when he offers it, and out-fish him to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, all levels, once. Four games count: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets. Pick the game you find easiest and finish it from start to end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is Lucia-only and her strand starts in Chapter 3 by call or text, with an address in Belville. Her five quests run in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton, marked by a green KR icon at Key Lento, hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He vanishes after Chapter 1, then texts Jason again later; the strand stays finishable after the story. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's five jobs come from the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; the last is Hometown Heroes. The strand stays available after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so watch the trophy's own in-game progress counter as you finish strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which gives you the Key Cloner: deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City, marked by a green RK icon. The Zorrusso delivered during that mission counts. Scan cars with WAiNK to check the list; hotel driveways at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, then take the final job, Shut Down the Labs. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Possibly missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house may be required, and the guides have not confirmed whether it is. Do it in Chapter 1 — talk to Lucia in the kitchen on the morning after Down to Earth, follow her, and Accept — to be safe.
trophies.guide: Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both characters at a spot counts +2. Track your count under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Possibly missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house, on the morning after Down to Earth — talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her and Accept. It adds +1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so whether it is required is unconfirmed; do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The last spot needs both characters, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. 100% needs only 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is Jason-only: he texts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and the first quest, Veteran Hunted, is in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks, marked in purple, and bring them back as Jason. Which animal triggers the trophy is unconfirmed in both guides, so work the decks and check the counter. 100% needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, and the first quest gives the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets. Eighteen sets exist, and the Progress menu's Collections page shows your per-set progress. Collect cards as you explore and finish three full sets — you do not need all eighteen.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations with the phone app: hold Up, then R1, to scan. The pools are 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan anything that glints as you travel and the counter climbs on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges, tracked under Progress, then Challenges. 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so treat 50 as a milestone on the way to the Platinum. Pick the challenges that suit your playstyle first — combat, driving and exploration all count.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star Wanted Level and get out of the red heat zone. You need both characters together, which means after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often pops there. A cited escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while still wanted — flashing red and blue, not the heat zone. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; rob a fourth if it does not pop. Three jewelry stores in north Vice City, after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, make a cited cluster.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch and 277 base models, of which 200 are needed for 100%. Scan every new vehicle you pass and the trophy comes quickly.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus: press L3 and R3 together while aiming to slow time. Fill Focus first with food and drink — Adrenaline extends it — and use an assault rifle. Gang-operation thugs count; cops, soldiers and civilians reportedly do not.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 are cited, while airfield-parked planes do not count. Enter the cockpit, back out to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport; the pop is delayed. Save first — the police respond fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island in Mariana County; the tanks sit at the south end of the base. Drive and shoot until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response, so save first and be ready to fight your way out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun for the locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm. Find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a cited target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape; 8 exist in total and 100% needs all 8. Vaults open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank and enter while the vault is open. Bring your partner — the haul is too heavy alone. Each vault pays up to $205,000, and Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. A bank-vault robbery counts automatically, so this often pops while you work on Maximum Withdrawal. The earlier method still works: box in a truck, sticky-bomb its back doors, then escape the red heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The guides say to fully unfog the map, fastest by plane over the dark patches. No opened source states an area count, so this guide claims none — Rockstar officially names six regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs, marked by yellow map icons; the Progress menu's Gangs page tracks your per-gang counts. Thirty-nine operations exist in total and 100% needs all 39, so this trophy is one operation per gang on the way to the full set.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet. The official description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, and both guides mark the exact steps unconfirmed. Until a walkthrough is confirmed, try the Ocean Beach bars with a view and watch for the pop — but treat any method you read as unconfirmed belief, not fact.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet. The official description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, and both guides mark the exact steps unconfirmed. Do not trust an unconfirmed method as fact — check the guides again before chasing it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the office safe in the north-east hallway, blown with Sticky Bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on pickup, and the items need not all be taken in one visit — the robbery respawns after a long time.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength for BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train at fitness clubs with your partner along — training one trains the other — and you can also train at home after the story. You need both characters, which means after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. PlayStation shows the running total when you open the trophy. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, then UI, to watch it climb. Profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and finally Irredeemable, which is permanent — avoid pushing that far. The count fills passively through robberies and fights.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet. One guide believes it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and the other only glosses the description — 'second time's the charm' — without a method. Belief is not a confirmed method, so treat any steps you read as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet. One guide believes it comes from a UFO questline, and the other only expects a strange event or Easter egg. Belief is not a confirmed method, so treat any steps you read as unconfirmed until a walkthrough is verified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet. The official description points to knocking people down with a melee drive-by. One guide believes it is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle, and the other glosses it as a melee attack from a vehicle. Belief is not a confirmed method, so treat any steps you read as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, cumulatively. You need the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, Meet Raul's Crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest. It counts everything you buy, so just play and spend normally — the trophy lands on its own well before the Platinum.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, for about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 you buy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission opens the app: take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked cars too. Keep free garage space for the cars you register.
